lyrics:
[Intro: filtered chords, soft shaker]

[Verse 1: smooth close male tenor]
No hurry in the water tonight
It goes the way it goes
Lean back, let the current decide
Wherever it wants us, we'll float

[Chorus: deep bass in, voice layered]
Lazy river, take it slow
Round and round and nowhere to go
Your hand on the tube next to mine
Lazy river, we've got time

[Drop: rolling bassline, chopped vocal]
Slow, slow (slow, slow)

[Verse 2: tenor, hi-hats ticking]
All day running, all week on the clock
Here the only speed is drift
You keep bumping into me soft
I keep not minding it

[Chorus: deep bass, voice layered]
Lazy river, take it slow
Round and round and nowhere to go
Your hand on the tube next to mine
Lazy river, we've got time

[Break: bass out, pads, whispered]
Once more around

[Final Chorus: full groove, filter opens]
Lazy river, take it slow
Round and round and nowhere to go
Your hand on the tube next to mine
Lazy river, we've got time

[Outro: chords filter down to nothing]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 117 BPM, 4/4, F minor. Slow, rolling and hypnotic deep house.

VOICE: Male tenor, silky and close, sung quietly with R&B turns, pitched a touch lower than natural. Layered in the choruses. A chopped two-word sample of his own voice in the drop. One whispered line in the break.

INSTRUMENTS: Filtered electric-piano chords that open and close, a rolling, rubbery sub-bass line, a soft kick on every beat, shakers and closed hi-hats, a clap with long reverb, warm pads.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, filtered chords. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:48 Chorus 1, bass in. 1:14 Drop. 1:30 Verse 2. 2:02 Chorus 2. 2:22 Break, pads only. 2:34 Final chorus. 2:56 Outro, the filter closes, ends 3:08.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2019 deep house: dark, smooth and bass-led, everything low-pass filtered and then slowly opened.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The bassline arriving under 'Lazy river, take it slow' at 0:48.

STATION FIT: 6 p.m., as the light turns. The first properly deep track of the evening, a bridge from the afternoon's sunny songs to the night set.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Unwinding, drifting, close, in no hurry.
